headline: Ransomware Attack Forces HI-LEX to Suspend Operations at Key Manufacturing Sites
body: Automotive parts provider HI-LEX Corp has halted activity at several major manufacturing facilities following a severe ransomware attack that compromised vital IT systems. The intrusion disrupted their execution and supply chain logistics, forcing production lines to cease temporarily. Experts in cybersecurity have been deployed to tackle the breach, but a timeline for resuming normal operations remains unclear. HI-LEX is working closely with external consultants to safeguard its infrastructure and mitigate further risks.
